name: reflection
description: 检查项目是否存在未完结的后续流程（TODO / 遗留风险 / 经验记录），生成 reflection-report.md。该 atom-task 是确认门：用户同意后才能进入 Done。

prompt.instruction: Walk targetDir for 'TODO', 'FIXME', 'XXX' markers added or untouched during this run. Combine that with the run's decisions log and verification history to produce reflection-report.md per the template: open items, recommended follow-ups, and lessons learned. End with the standard 用户确认 section.
guardrails: Scan only targetDir; do not crawl outside it.
When listing TODO items, cite file path and (if available) line number.
Phrase follow-ups as actionable tasks, not free-form prose.
